notes.title: Game Update v5.1.0
notes.notes: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: 100 Years’ War version 2.0.4 update
notes.notes: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: 100 Years’ War Version 2.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Units will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
[*] Fix: An issue with image scaling on older Apple iOS devices.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: Some unit animations working erratically.
[*] Update: Campaign map graphics. It is now clearer which campaigns have been completed.
[*] Update; Play balance in Velmont Pt.2.
[*] Update: 'About Game' window.
[*] Update: Play balance in some missions.
[*] Update: Source information in the credits.
[*] Update: Source material credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Update.
notes.notes:
Change: Updated some move and shoot multipliers.
Fix: Minor case issues in some test.
Fix: Values for disorganised units.
Fix: Small errors in some unit entity specs.

Any issues please let us know at support@hexwar.com
